limitation: Interested presidential account and retrospective justification; establishes attributed rhetoric and a stated prior willingness to forgo control, not present sincerity or a binding future settlement position.
observation: In the year-end press conference, Putin called Odessa and the Black Sea coast historically Russian while also stating that Russia had reconciled itself to the post-Soviet territorial arrangement and had been prepared to live within that paradigm before the post-2014 rupture.
